scope_label: investigating causes of a quality problem
definition: Root cause analysis is a structured investigation of the causal conditions behind a problem, undertaken to identify changes that could prevent it from recurring.
explanation: Begin with a clear account of what happened, then examine the process and test plausible explanations against evidence. A cause-and-effect diagram or repeated “why” questions can generate hypotheses; neither proves a cause by itself.
Several conditions may have contributed. An action aimed only at the visible symptom may contain the immediate problem without addressing why it arose.
